name: nickkk-skills
description: Agent skills. nk-novel, nk-design, nk-data-story make something new from one idea; the others stop an AI coding agent's "done, tested, safe" from being taken on faith: evidence bundles, breakable checks, guardrails, memory and handoff discipline.

plugins.name: nk-evidence-audit
plugins.description: Turn "done, fixed, tested" into evidence a second agent judges.

plugins.name: nk-git-guardrail-hook
plugins.description: A PreToolUse hook for Claude Code that stops before the git and shell commands that have actually destroyed work — force push, git add -A in a shared checkout, making a repo public, pushing while behind the remote, a push that records a mass deletion, rm -rf on a project root, curl piped into a shell — and names the incident in the prompt.

plugins.name: nk-publish-gate
plugins.description: Privacy and secret gate to run before anything goes public — a repo, a release zip, a demo folder, a PDF.

plugins.name: nk-indent-guard
plugins.description: Stop a one-line edit to a JSON or YAML data file from re-indenting the whole file and burying the real change in a 400-line diff.

plugins.name: nk-breakable-selftest
plugins.description: Make a checker, validator, linter, gate or test suite prove it can fail.

plugins.name: nk-memory-with-conditions
plugins.description: Write agent memories that say when they hold, and keep the memory directory honest.

plugins.name: nk-rules-that-land
plugins.description: Write rules for an AI agent that actually change what it does.

plugins.name: nk-regression-baseline
plugins.description: Freeze the byte-exact output of production code on its default inputs before you change it, and compare after.

plugins.name: nk-rewrite-coverage
plugins.description: After rewriting a long document — a spec, a research report, a handbook — list what the old version had that the new one no longer mentions, and account for every item with a three-state verdict before the rewrite is accepted.

plugins.name: nk-handoff-package
plugins.description: Hand a line of work to an executor that has no context — another agent, a contractor, a future session — so that the work comes back checkable.

plugins.name: nk-novel
plugins.description: Turn one story idea into a staged novel plan that holds together, plus a one-page visual story bible.

plugins.name: nk-design
plugins.description: Build a single-file data tool from one sentence (a review queue, a ledger, a tracker, an admin panel) in a design system where every number shows where it came from and what was not checked.

plugins.name: nk-data-story
plugins.description: Turn a CSV or Excel file into a one-page data report whose headline is the conclusion and where every figure states its denominator, window and filter.
